reviews.review_description: Very knowledgeable sales staff answered all our questions and gave us great options in the choice of system required. The installers were pleasant, courteous and on time. Very tidy workmanship. Great pricing compared with other companies we researched.

After 4 yrs system has earth fault. Contacted them and gave invoice number but nothing. Sent email asking to be be passed onto management and still no reply.Paid for extra panels so had 6.6kw panels and 5kw inverter. Never reached 5kw on inverter.Paid extra for extended warranty for these kind of problems but shows it’s a waste of money if company has poor customer service.
Buggered up our wiring on install .After 2nd inverter crapped itself .They would not return any off our calls .1000$ later SOLARGAIN saved the day ??

From start to finish this company was excellent. Rhett was a pleasure to deal with and nothing was too much trouble. Everything was handled for me I had to do nothing. They were punctual and did a really good job which I am delighted with.

We recently purchased 2 systems , one for ourselves and one for my son. Rhett was a pleasure to deal with and nothing was too much trouble. there was no pressure in the whole transaction. We picked 2 high quality systems and the price was extremely pleasing. A big thanks to the installation team of Ron, Ryan and James. Nothing was an issue and the installs were  of the highest quality. An absolute highest  quality installation team, clean up and attention to detail exceptional.  A big thanks to the whole team of SolarWA. Would highly recommend them to anyone.

After dealing with other solar companies I found Solar WA very helpful and great value. Rhett explained things to me in a way I would understand and canâ€™t thank him enough. My solar panels were installed only a few days after the phone call and I found Solar WA to be very professional and would highly recommend. Very glad I chose them.
Very friendly service and extremely helpful. Had cheaper quotes but Solar WA seemed to answer my questions more directly so felt comfortable using them.
All round good service couldn't ask for more thanks.
The sales team were extremely helpful and transparent in regards to cost.The service was fast.I'm so happy.the guys went the extra mile and removed my hot water system.

In general a good all round experience. Had a small issue after a year's installation and was promptly rectified.

Rhett helped me with choosing the right system for my home. I must have asked him a billion questions as I knew nothing about solar. Now I feel I know so much about it I could sell them myself.He answered all my questions numerous times especially when I didnâ€™t understand how the solar panels worked.He made me feel very important individual not like a number and made sure I understood everything concerning my solar systemExcellent Service
Rhett was very knowledgeable and professional and extremely organised and on the ball. He made the transaction fromSales to installation very easy would definitely recommend him and solar wa

Excellent system at a good price.Installers service was excellent also. Special mention to Katherine & helper who made good suggestions during installation & installed to a high standard.Very professional service

Vlad yet again was brilliant and very knowledgeable in his chosen field and credit must go to Katherine and Ron, the installation team, who arrived on time and did an extremely neat job.Overall the biggest complement I can pay is that if I had a solar company I would wantthese people on-board this is the 3rd system we have had from this team on different houses.Well done

Solar wa installed my system January 2016, my inverter decided to not work anymore so I contacted Domini, she got my inverter changed in less than 2 weeks... easy and fast! I am a happy customer since day 1

The installing team were fantastic nothing was a drama and made me the customer believe that they had my interests at heart (such a welcome surprise ) i could tell they took pride in their work and were experienced installers - the work was carried out professionally and left my premises the same way as it was before (no mess).A big thank you.
Polite..helpful ..friendly..explained everything..great service

Rhett was very pleasant to do business with, especially in comparison to 3 other companies I received quotes from.  Rhett was not pushy at all and everything he advised would happen did.  The installation was done without any inconvenience.Extremely happy we I went with Solar WA in all aspects, the service from Rhett, the installation and the results I can see already are brilliant

I was looking for a 10kw system and wanted a specific brand of inverter to be installed. I also required a very long run of cable to the meter box and extra's. I started getting quotes but was all getting too hard, they either wanted to do 2x5kw systems or refused to use the inverter i wanted. Long story short, i called Rhett from Solarwa and he came out to have a look. Nice bloke, not pushy and nothing was too hard for them,great price, top quality system and install. Very happy with the performance of the system and Very highly recommended!!! (Saving aprox $800 per bill in summer and around $400 in winter.)
Rhett was very helpful & the installation by Catherine was a professionally done.The inverter was a Goodwe with Tier 1 panels, a very good system for the money....

Rhett was very friendly and knowledgeable in setting up the install. The team that installed on the day worked very hard with a tough job and were caring and considerate working around my newborn daughter. They worked non stop from 7am to past 5pm and everything is installed perfectly
Great experience from start to finish, very polite and clean install team, nothing was too big a problem, great system

It was a 5kW Huawei Inverter with 6.6kW of ET Panels.I was very impressed with the time and care taken with install. Kath and her team did a great job. They tidied up afterwards and explained the system to me.I was able to get the iPhone app software NetEco up and running and register the plant with Huawei with the help of Jack Li from Huawei Australia even though the Home Fusion app worked right away through the inverter Wi-Fi by directly logging onto the inverter.The Huawei Inverter itself and associated software is impressive and importantly it is a battery ready hybrid inverter.I have a lot of confidence with both the installer and this inverter and I feel like I have spent my money wisely and well.
Me and my wife are very happy, excellent service,price, and the installers did a neat job on all the wiring.

6.6k opal panels 5k zeversolar inverter. Vlad was a pleasure to dea with and I felt like we designed and configured my solar solution together. Brett and his team did the install on a day mixed with rain and sun, the guys were professional courteous and a real pleasure. Canâ€™t rave enough about these guys... in fact accidentally convinced 2 colleagues to upgrade their arrays just from my experience with SolarWa. Thanks solarquotes for helping me find these guys!
Your website was very helpful in educating us on domestic solar to a point where we felt confident to discuss quotations with two of your three recommended vendors.
24 Talsun panels 6.8KW and Goodwe 5KW inverter
Wish installer had tried harder to install the panels further from the front elevation of my house because now it is visible from the street. There is ample roof with no shadow to achieve this.

I'm pretty sure that this company is mentioned on your site and that's where I got their info from. However it was not one of the 3 companies you supplied for quotes. Out of the 3 only one responded. At the time Infinite Energy responded they didn't have German made panels which is what I wanted. In the end however I chose Jinko panels and a Fronius inverter.  Choice magazine rated Jinko panels highly in their 1 year test results of a large number of panels. It really came down to me doing so much research and becoming overwhelmed I became a ditherer so I just bit the bullet and made a decision to get a good inverter because this is the workhorse - as you pointed out thankyou. - and good panels that didn't cost an arm and leg again which you explained on your site. All in all I'm happy although haven't had a bill as yet. Your site was invaluable Finn for my research and final decision on what to buy. Thankyou keep up the good work we need as much information that we can get.

If I was to do this again I would not do it so close to Xmas / New Year as if there are any questions after installation there is access to support staff. As I have issues connecting to the inverter wifi, I now have to wait a couple of weeks before the problem can be rectified.

All three companies got back to me within 10 days. One rang me on the first day which was impressive.The reps who came out to do the quotes were all very helpful and informative. I asked a lot of questions and wanted them to show me how long it would take to pay off the system (in reduced electricity costs) using my usage figures as well as explaining the differences between different brands of inverters and panels.I found  Finn Peacock's checklist (for comparing solar power apples with apples) to be very useful in making the decision on which provider.I would've happily gone with any of the three companies in terms of quality of service and products, so in the end went with the company which provided the best price.
Really great experience. Very good quote with good follow up. They can when they said did a very neat tidy and quick job. highly recommend

Everything ran very smoothly, and we would have no hesitation in recommending Solar WA.  Whilst the panels they stock were not the ones we wanted, they went out of their way to make sure we got the panels of our choice.

Only recently installed so we have yet to have savings experience. The installers were excellent. We had a problem manifest itself on installation which was not elated to the system. The guys tracked it back to the source although it was not their problem.
Salesperson was very helpful in making suggestions for placing panels for most efficient supply. Also helpful with the use of appliances to for most efficient results.
The installers were very professional , on time and very tidy. Would have no hesitation in recommending this company.

Great service with no BS. With the weather as it is (very wet) I thought they would cancel but they came on time and installed the 5kW system by 2pm. Very pleasant workers and tidy, I would  recommend them anytime.
Installer communication was a bit poor.

Of the 3 companies sourced from this website, Rhett from Solar WA was the 2nd caller however the 1st to quote onsite. His was the best price from the word go and also came down in price voluntarily to seal the deal. I contacted 2 x other companies and one was the same, the other not even close.The was a small issue in that all 24 panels were to be installed on both north facing roof aspects, however this was not viable due to roof design and 11 panels were installed on the west aspect as well. Not a big deal simply evens out power output over the day.Due to the double story construction of the house the inverter cable run to the garage was not able to be achieved so inverter was installed outside above power meter box. They are returning to fit a cover to shield the inverter from the sun.Installation was almost immediate. Installation  was only a few days after submitting paperwork to Western Power.SOLAR WA was prompt, priced very well, a team of 3 installers on the day, arrived on time, installed in one day. Its the middle of winter and on sunny days averaged 22 k/w and cloudy days 14/kw on a 5k/w fronius inverter and 24 x panels 270w canadian 6.5 k/w ratings.I can recommend this company.

Thanks to the information made available by Solar Quotes I was able to go through the process with sufficient confidence that I understood what system would best suit my needs and from reading the various reviews, I had a good idea of what type of inverters and panels were available. Prior to getting quotes I had already decided upon a system that would include a Fronius 5kW inverter and tier one panels. Solar WA provided me with a very competitive quote for the Fronius inverter and JA Solar panels (16 x 320kW). Rhett from Solar WA was very helpful and the friendly team from AGF Electrical who installed the system did an excellent job and were very tidy. They were also happy to answer several questions I had in the following days. Thanks to Solar Quotes and Solar WA for making the process a smooth and stress-free experience.
Question 5 is a bit of a nonsense; How do I tell the quality with any degree of objective technical relevance?It all looks good on paper, but that is just what it is; performance is the key here.
We have a complicated architect designed house which created a very tricky situation for the electrician. Despite that, the job was completed relatively quickly and to our satisfaction.
SolarWA were brilliant from start to finish. Quote was for a system far superior to another company's recommendation and for a much better price. Installation was excellent.

The guys who came out on Monday to install the system did a great job. They arrived on time, cleaned up after themselves, and helped set the Fronius up for me.  Very happy with their professionalism.  Rhett, who came out and gave us a quote, was very good at explaining how things work.
Installers were safe and well qualified.
Installed 3 weeks ago....so far excellent in all respects!
overall the service worked well. ..thanks for your help
They were prompt with their quote and prompt with their installation
Could not be happier with the product, price and service.
Salesman & Installers were top notch, Nice bunch of aussie guys, were very professional and clean and tidy.

After doing the math initially on my power bills, i realized i needed to do something, and with a family of 6, the only option was solar. I was expecting to be able to reduce my bills from the usual $700 - $900 i was paying each billing period to around the $500 mark to help easy the bill shock.After having the system installed for entire billing period, i was astonished at how much it saved me and how well it exceeded my expectations. I've just had my first bill under $300 in a decade. I produced just over 2000kWh for the billing period, of which nearly 1200kWh was used directly by my house, leaving 800kWh that was pumped back into the grid. My total bill for the billing period was just $263.At this stage my solar system will pay for itself entirely inside 3 yrs, leaving me very safe from further bill horror long into the future.My only regret is not doing it sooner.
Answered all my queries and I had quite a few. Professional in all aspects.
Uses own trades people and not subbies. Sets up and programmes the Wi Fi to Fronius inverter with instruction how to use. Visits you at your home and not over the phone.
